item.title: Trump says U.S. has "total control" over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: President Trump said Wednesday that the U.S. has "total control" over the Strait of Hormuz, writing on social media: "I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT."

item.title: Europe sees total solar eclipse: "A very grand thing connected to something bigger than yourself"
item.description: A total solar eclipse turned day into night across a slice of Europe and North America on Wednesday, and put millions in unique contact with the heavens above. Meteorologist Rob Marciano reports from Spain.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy sobs in court as medical examiner describes children's injuries before they died
item.description: Lindsay Clancy had an emotional day in court on Wednesday in the trial for killing her three children. She's fighting murder charges, saying she was suffering from postpartum psychosis and overmedication. Shanelle Kaul reports.

item.title: Miraculous rescue gives moment of hope in Colombia after devastating earthquake
item.description: 48 hours after the devastating earthquake in Colombia, its president said the death toll jumped to 181 people, and thousands were still reported missing. Lilia Luciano reports on a rescue effort in a hard-hit city.

item.title: 11 charged for alleged sham marriages to help Chinese nationals get green cards
item.description: The DOJ unveiled criminal charges alleging 11 people participated in a scheme that involved more than 1,000 "sham marriages" between Chinese nationals and U.S. citizens.

item.title: 2 killed as Apache helicopter from Fort Hood crashes in Salado, Texas
item.description: Two soldiers aboard an AH-64 Apache attack helicopter based out of Fort Hood were killed in a crash on Wednesday, according to local authorities and the Army.

item.title: Army Apache helicopter crashes, killing 2 crew members
item.description: An AH-64 Army Apache helicopter crashed on Wednesday, killing both crew members on board. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: Flash flood emergency hits Midwestern states
item.description: Illinois and Ohio were hit with a flash flood emergency this week as a long line of storms dumped heavy rain on the Midwest. Boats had to travel down what should be roadways for rescue efforts. Meg Oliver reports and Lonnie Quinn has the forecast.

item.title: Surrogate gives birth to baby at center of multi-state legal battle
item.description: Surrogate McKenna West declined to get an abortion requested by the intended parents after the baby she was carrying was diagnosed with a severe but treatable heart defect.

item.title: Political strategists on Crowley upset of Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
item.description: Republican strategist Matt Whitlock and Hannah Muldavin, deputy communications director for the DNC, join "The Takeout" to discuss Tuesday's primaries and David Crowley's win in Wisconsin over Francesca Hong.

item.title: Maps and charts show record number of measles cases in U.S. this year
item.description: CBS News has been tracking a record number of measles cases and outbreaks around the country. The majority of cases are among those who haven't been vaccinated.

item.title: Whole Foods recalls some jalapeño products over salmonella risk
item.description: Certain salsas, guacamole, pico de gallo and prepared jalapeño products at Whole Foods are among the products recalled over possible salmonella risk.

item.title: New book, "How the Democrats Screwed Bernie," argues party establishment tanked Sanders in 2016
item.description: Tad Devine, the chief strategist for Bernie Sanders' 2016 presidential campaign, argues in his new book that members of the Democratic Party's establishment conspired to prevent Sanders from capturing the nomination. The book is called "How the Democrats Screwed Bernie." Devine joined "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: H.R. McMaster on Trump's secret plane switch: "It seems like the system worked"
item.description: President Trump's former national security adviser, H.R. McMaster, joins "The Takeout" to share his thoughts on the president's secret plane switch last month in response to an Iranian threat, as well as the latest developments in the Iran war.

item.title: Trump's secret plane switch took place within a day of credible missile threat
item.description: President Trump secretly moved from Air Force One to another plane within a day of U.S. and Turkish intelligence picking up on an Iranian plot to fire a missile at the jet, CBS News has learned.

item.title: Brian Poindexter on his race against embattled Rep. Max Miller
item.description: Democrat Brian Poindexter is seeing new interest in his Ohio campaign for Congress as his opponent, GOP Rep. Max Miller, faces allegations of abuse. Poindexter joined "The Takeout" to discuss the race.

item.title: Details on Karoline Leavitt's departure as press secretary
item.description: Karoline Leavitt announced Wednesday that she will leave her role as White House press secretary at the end of the month. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe has more on that and the latest on President Trump's secret plane switch.

item.title: Student shot during argument in Georgia high school bathroom, officials say
item.description: An argument in the bathroom of a high school in Warner Robins, Georgia, ended with one student shot and another in custody, officials said.

item.title: Judge calls breaks after Lindsay Clancy sobs during murder trial: "I can't do it"
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's murder trial was paused multiple times Wednesday afternoon as she sobbed loudly and said "I can't do it" during testimony.

item.title: Luke Bronin on his stunning primary upset of 14-term Rep. John Larson in Connecticut
item.description: Luke Bronin beat 14-term Democratic Rep. John Larson in Tuesday night's primary for Connecticut's 1st congressional district. Bronin joined "The Takeout" to discuss his win.

item.title: Painting a picture of the solar eclipse in Europe: "Like being on another planet"
item.description: The moon passed in front of the sun, blocking its light for a total solar eclipse over parts of Europe on Wednesday. CBS News national weather correspondent Rob Marciano paints a picture from Mallorca, Spain, and Brian Gold, who witnessed the eclipse, joins with his thoughts.

item.title: Key takeaways from Tuesday's primaries, including Crowley's win over Hong in Wisconsin and more
item.description: Tuesday's primaries in six states provided a blurry picture of the U.S. electorate. On the Democratic side, some progressives won and some lost while Republicans also saw mixed results for President Trump's endorsed candidates. CBS News' Major Garrett, Jonah Kaplan, Taurean Small and Anthony Salvanto break down all the results.

item.title: Rubio, Bessent took decoy Air Force One, Hegseth flew on secret flight with Trump
item.description: Secretaries Marco Rubio and Scott Bessent were on the decoy flight last month when President Trump secretly switched to a different plane while Pete Hegseth was with Mr. Trump.

item.title: Eli Lilly takes aim at illicit market for its experimental weight-loss drug
item.description: The pharmaceutical company is filing lawsuits against six outlets selling versions of its promising but unapproved weight-loss drug, retatrutide.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt exiting as White House press secretary
item.description: President Trump said Karoline Leavitt will be leaving her role to focus on her young family.

item.title: Total solar eclipse darkens skies across Northern Hemisphere
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 crossed the Northern Hemisphere today, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See photos and video from the best viewing locations.

item.title: The ins and outs of egg freezing | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez began sharing on social media that she is going to try to preserve her fertility by freezing her eggs, a subject that Lesley Stahl reported on in 2025. Stahl found that the costly procedure brought happy endings to some women, but offered no guarantees.

item.title: Nick Reiner indicted on murder charges in parents' killings at their LA home
item.description: Nick Reiner pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder with the special circumstance allegations in the killings of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner.

item.title: Norah O'Donnell: I take testosterone. Here's why.
item.description: Norah O'Donnell sat down with her own doctor, Rachel Rubin, to tackle the important topic of menopause: How your body changes, why women may be needlessly suffering, and what you can actually do about it.

item.title: U.S. and Iran close to "peace arrangement or a deal," Pakistan says
item.description: The U.S. and Iran are close to agreeing on "some sort of arrangement," Pakistan's defense minister told Bloomberg on Tuesday.
